criteria.criterion: A word is expanded exactly when it holds a `$` unquoted or in double quotes, an unquoted `*` or `?`, an unquoted `[` with an unquoted `]` later in the word, or an unquoted `{` and the first unquoted `}` after it (no unquoted `{` between) with an unquoted `,` or `..` between them. Violation: a single-quoted, double-quoted (for a glob or brace) or backslash-escaped `$`, glob or brace read as any text (`git '$X' origin`, `git "pu*" origin`, `git pu\$X origin` stay allowed), or `@{u}`, `{}`, `HEAD@{1}`, `[ -f x ]` read as expanded.
